skill.name: background-removal
skill.description: Remove image backgrounds with BiRefNet through the inference.sh belt CLI. It supports transparent PNG cutouts, background edits, and product or portrait workflows.
skill.summary: Create transparent image cutouts through the inference.sh belt CLI.
skill.author: inference-sh

security_audit.summary: Static findings mostly come from Markdown command examples and documentation URLs. Real risk remains because the skill uses the belt CLI to call remote inference services and can send image URLs or generated assets outside the local environment.

remediation.suggestion: Limit allowed Bash access to the specific belt subcommands needed for background removal when the skill format supports finer permissions.
State clearly that image URLs, prompts, and generated assets may be processed by inference.sh or fal.ai services.
Mark npx skills add examples as optional and require explicit user confirmation before installing related skills.

content.value_statement: Manual cutouts slow product, portrait, and marketing workflows. This skill runs remote background removal through the inference.sh belt CLI.
actual_capabilities: Runs BiRefNet background removal through the belt CLI using an image URL.
Creates transparent PNG outputs for product photos, portraits, and design assets.
Uses fal.ai Reve examples for background removal and background replacement edits.
Shows a generate-then-edit workflow that combines image generation with background removal.
Links to inference.sh documentation for running apps and image workflows.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI and a valid login before use.
Processes images through external services instead of local offline tools.
Needs an accessible image URL or generated image URL as input.
Output quality depends on source image clarity, subject edges, and model behavior.

use_cases.title: Clean Product Listings
use_cases.description: Remove busy photo backgrounds and create transparent product images for catalogs, ads, and storefronts.

use_cases.title: Prepare Portrait Assets
use_cases.description: Create clean headshot cutouts for team pages, campaign graphics, and social media profile images.

use_cases.title: Build Composite Graphics
use_cases.description: Generate or import an image, remove the background, and place the subject into a new design.

prompt_templates.title: Remove a Background
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner cutout from one image URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Remove the background from this image URL and return a transparent PNG result: [image URL].

prompt_templates.title: Create Product Cutouts
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare transparent background cutouts for these product image URLs. Keep the product edges clean and preserve natural shadows when possible.

prompt_templates.title: Replace the Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Change the background of this image to [new background]. Keep the main subject realistic and centered.

prompt_templates.title: Generate and Isolate an Asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a simple mascot from this description, remove its background, and provide a transparent PNG suitable for a design system.

output_examples.input: A product photo URL with a cluttered table and wall behind the item.
output_examples.output: A transparent PNG where the product is isolated, centered, and ready for a storefront image slot.

output_examples.input: A portrait image URL with an office background.
output_examples.output: A clean headshot cutout with the person separated from the original background.

output_examples.input: A generated mascot image that needs to become a reusable sticker asset.
output_examples.output: A transparent PNG mascot asset that can be placed on slides, websites, or social posts.

best_practices: Use high-resolution images with clear contrast between the subject and background.
Confirm that image URLs are safe to share with external inference services.
Review edge quality before publishing assets in product pages or brand materials.
anti_patterns: Do not use private or regulated images without approval for remote processing.
Do not expect perfect cutouts from blurry images or low-contrast edges.
Do not run optional related-skill install commands without explicit user consent.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps remove image backgrounds using BiRefNet through the inference.sh belt CLI.

faq.question: Does it create transparent PNG files?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented output is a PNG with a transparent background.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: No. It depends on the belt CLI and remote inference services.

faq.question: Can it replace a background instead of removing it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes Reve examples for changing a background to a requested scene.

faq.question: What inputs does it need?
faq.answer: It needs an accessible image URL, or an image URL produced by a prior generation step.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive images?
faq.answer: Use caution. The workflow may send image URLs and content to external services.
